title: 第23章 天人出手狩猎开始第24章 刁蛮小公主一根发丝斩杀七大宗师
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: “这灵媒大祭司虽然被杀，但他们操控的那些凶兽，却是发了疯的朝大虞方向去了。”
“不知殿下会不会有麻烦。”
这灵媒大祭司虽然斩杀，眼下这些凶兽也失去了控制，但这数日内已经不知道被操控了多少，早已经汇聚向秋岚山脉蛰伏起来，等待发起攻击。
这些凶兽妖兽，本就对皇朝中的人类充满了敌意。
即便不被灵媒一族操控引导，也曾不止一次的发生过兽潮袭击。
镜没有在此多留，直接赶向大虞京城。
此刻。
大虞京城中。
洛游盘坐在自己的府中，得知灵媒大祭司那里一切顺利，心中不禁有几分得意。
他能与那大祭司合作，自然是付出了不少代价，除此之外还许诺他们可以随意通过自己进入大虞，甚至以大虞中的情报作为交换。
大虞中的不少强者信息，都已经被灵媒一族所掌握。
对于灵媒一族的野心，洛游心底并不在乎。
他甚至盼着有一日灵媒一族会进攻大虞，届时他便可以在大虞与灵媒之间谋取各种好处，不管最终谁占的便宜，吃亏的总不会是他洛家。
洛游心情大好，脸上扬起笑容。
区区一个废物六皇子，也配与他争黎清月？
他虽只是武宁侯世子，但修为早已经修炼到了八阶化意巅峰！
若非自身藏拙，其真正的天赋与实力，完全不亚于几位皇子。
甚至，若真正一战，他有自信超过几位皇子中的半数！
他并非出生在京城之中，而是父亲武宁侯带其生母前往海外做客拜访途中所诞生。
一生下来，他便身具大气运。
种种异象伴身，甚至引得海外仙岛一位前辈现身，破例将其收为义子。
不过是父亲谨慎，担心自己锋芒太盛，这才让他处处收敛。
他自幼随义父潜修，不仅修炼家族所掌握的大虞皇朝功法，更是修有海外仙宗神通。
同样，与灵媒一族合作间，也掌握了些许简单的灵媒术法。
正因如此，他才能够听到那灵媒大祭司的传音。
放眼这整个大虞，除却几大皇子外，论身份与天赋，无几人能与他相比，自然更不是其他几大王府侯府中，那些只知享受玩乐的纨绔子弟，可以相提并论的。
这也是为何，他有底气得到黎清月的主要原因。
所以对于孟尘这个六皇子。
他心底压根不放在眼里。
不过，既然他敢染指黎清月，那就怪不得自己对其动手了。
洛游心底冷笑的同时，自然还不知道，灵媒大祭司刚与他传完音，便已经嘎了。
而且。
在临死之前，还将这口锅算到了他的头上。
与此同时。
灵媒一族所在的大漠深处。
大祭司传回的灵媒血音，也在无数灵媒族强者脑海中回荡。
“该死！”
“好卑鄙的人类！”
“好歹毒的武宁侯世子！”
“此子假意与我族合作，利用完却翻手害之，灭杀了我族数位英杰与一位大祭司，真当我族没有强者吗！”
“本来欲利用此子，更进一步掌握大虞的底蕴，趁机渗透，夺取足够的富饶之地为我灵媒一族所有。”
“现在看来，是我等失算了。”
content_en:
"Although the psychic high priest was killed, the ferocious beasts they controlled went crazy towards Dayu."
"I wonder if His Highness will be in trouble."
Although the psychic high priest killed them and these ferocious beasts were now out of control, they had been controlled to an unknown extent in the past few days. They had already gathered towards the Qiulan Mountains and were dormant, waiting to launch an attack.
These ferocious beasts were originally full of hostility towards the humans in the dynasty.
Even if they are not controlled and guided by the psychic clan, there have been attacks by beast waves more than once.
Jing did not stay here longer and rushed directly to the capital of Dayu.
…
at this moment.
In the capital city of Dayu.
Luo You sat cross-legged in his mansion and couldn't help but feel a little proud when he learned that everything went well with the psychic high priest.
He was able to cooperate with the high priest, and naturally paid a lot of price. In addition, he also promised that they could enter Dayu through him at will, and even exchanged information about Dayu.
Information about many powerful people in Dayu has been mastered by the psychic clan.
Luo You didn't care about the ambitions of the psychic family.
He even looked forward to the day when the psychic family would attack Dayu, and then he would be able to seek various benefits between Dayu and the psychics. No matter who took advantage in the end, it would not be his Luo family who suffered.
Luo You was in a good mood, with a smile on his face.
A mere good-for-nothing Sixth Prince, is he worthy of competing with him for Li Qingyue?
Although he is only the prince of Wuninghou, his cultivation has already reached the peak of the eighth level of mind transformation!
If it weren't for his own clumsiness, his true talent and strength would be no less than those of several princes.
Even if there is a real battle, he is confident that he can surpass half of the princes!
He was not born in the capital, but was born when his father, Marquis Wuning, took his biological mother overseas for a visit.
He was born with great luck.
Accompanied by various strange phenomena, a senior from an overseas fairy island even appeared and made an exception to adopt him as his adopted son.
But it was his father who was cautious and worried that he was too sharp, so he restrained himself in everything.
He has been cultivating with his adoptive father since he was a child. Not only did he practice the Dayu Dynasty skills mastered by his family, but he also cultivated the supernatural powers of overseas immortals.
Similarly, by cooperating with a family of psychics, he also mastered some simple psychic techniques.
Because of this, he was able to hear the message from the psychic high priest.
Looking at the entire Great Yu, except for the few princes, there are not many people who can compare with him in terms of status and talent. Naturally, they cannot be compared with those playboys in the other princes' mansions who only know how to enjoy themselves.
This is also the main reason why he has the confidence to get Li Qingyue.
So for Meng Chen, the sixth prince.
He didn't take it seriously at all.
However, since he dared to get his hands on Li Qingyue, no wonder he took action against him.
While Luo You was sneering in his heart, he naturally didn't know that the psychic medium priest had just finished communicating with him, and he was already dead.
and.
Before he died, he put the blame on his head.
at the same time.
Deep in the desert where the psychic family lives.
The blood sound of the psychic medium sent back by the high priest also echoed in the minds of countless powerful psychics.
"Damn it!"
"What a despicable human being!"
"The vicious Prince Wuning!"
"This man pretended to cooperate with our clan, but after using it, he turned around and harmed him. He killed several heroes and a high priest of our clan. Do you really think that our clan has no strong people!"
"I originally wanted to use this son to further understand Dayu's background, seize the opportunity to infiltrate, and seize enough fertile land for my family of psychics."
"Now it seems that I made a miscalculation."
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
title_en: Chapter 23: Heavenly beings take action to hunt. Chapter 24: The unruly little princess kills the seven great masters with a hair.
